rules.statement: A borrower is not competent to move a Court to invalidate the resolution of selling mortgaged property by public auction, as per Section 29D of the People's Bank Act No. 29 of 1961.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 29(D) sets out that it shall not be competent for the borrower to move any Court to invalidate such a resolution for any cause whatsoever, and no Court shall entertain such an application."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 29 D of the People's Bank Act No. 29 of 1961 as amended by Act No. 32 of 1986
